200.description:
Search the NEVO food table by name (Dutch or English), synonym or NEVO code, optionally restricted to one food group. Returns one page of foods with their names, group, remark, trace and fortification markers and a chosen set of nutrient values per 100 g (energy, water, protein, fat, carbohydrate, fibre, alcohol, organic acids and ash by default). The site has no server-side search: the program downloads the full table (about 12 MB) and filters it, so each call takes a few seconds.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `foods` as the primary payload key.
